title: Mismatches in type for property registrations in ClassDB for some classes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot_v4.6-dev3 however for example XRPose is incorrect going back to Godot 4.0 ( 5d1ea92daf3eb2b9d7688b43568e8f2d0b7c0ab8 )

### System information

Garuda Linux (Arch-based), kernel LTS 

### Issue description

For multiple classes, the wrong type in `PropertyInfo` is registered for it’s properties. I encountered this when I wrote my own object serialization function, which can take arbitrary Objects, and utilizes the  `get_property_list()` function to first serialize, and then deserialize objects. For storing it iterated the properties with a storage flag and then serialized the Variant, for reading you pass an “empty” example object, and it repopulates the data by reading the correct type from the binary stream. I did this with `XRPose` however encountered errors when reading back serialized files. I then noticed that for example the property `angular_velocity` is added with:
```cpp
ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "angular_velocity"), "set_angular_velocity", "get_angular_velocity"); // Incorrect -> Would need to be VECTOR3
```
This means my script serialized a `Vector3` (because it had a Variant instance it used), but then tried to read a `String`, which was not contained in the binary data stream.

I then wrote a simple script to find more occurrences of this problem (see MRP).
The complete list of incorrectly registered properties is here:

<details>
  <summary>List of incorrect definitions (click to expand)</summary>
  
  
```
Class: AudioEffectPitchShift
  Property: oversampling declared as float but getter get_oversampling returns int

Class: CodeEdit
  Property: line_length_guidelines declared as PackedInt32Array but getter get_line_length_guidelines returns Array
  Property: delimiter_strings declared as PackedStringArray but getter get_string_delimiters returns Array
  Property: delimiter_comments declared as PackedStringArray but getter get_comment_delimiters returns Array
  Property: code_completion_prefixes declared as PackedStringArray but getter get_code_completion_prefixes returns Array
  Property: indent_automatic_prefixes declared as PackedStringArray but getter get_auto_indent_prefixes returns Array

Class: ConvexPolygonShape3D
  Property: points declared as Array but getter get_points returns PackedVector3Array

Class: Curve
  Property: _limits declared as Nil but getter _get_limits returns Array
  Property: _data declared as int but getter _get_data returns Array

Class: Curve2D
  Property: _data declared as int but getter _get_data returns Dictionary

Class: Curve3D
  Property: _data declared as int but getter _get_data returns Dictionary

Class: EditorSpinSlider
  Property: control_state declared as bool but getter get_control_state returns int

Class: GLTFObjectModelProperty
  Property: json_pointers declared as PackedStringArray but getter get_json_pointers returns Array

Class: NavigationMeshSourceGeometryData3D
  Property: vertices declared as PackedVector3Array but getter get_vertices returns PackedFloat32Array

Class: OpenXRMarkerTracker
  Property: bounds_size declared as int but getter get_bounds_size returns Vector2

Class: OpenXRPlaneTracker
  Property: bounds_size declared as int but getter get_bounds_size returns Vector2

Class: RegExMatch
  Property: strings declared as Array but getter get_strings returns PackedStringArray

Class: RenderSceneBuffersConfiguration
  Property: fsr_sharpness declared as bool but getter get_fsr_sharpness returns float
  Property: texture_mipmap_bias declared as bool but getter get_texture_mipmap_bias returns float

Class: WebSocketPeer
  Property: heartbeat_interval declared as int but getter get_heartbeat_interval returns float

Class: XRPose
  Property: transform declared as String but getter get_transform returns Transform3D
  Property: linear_velocity declared as String but getter get_linear_velocity returns Vector3
  Property: angular_velocity declared as String but getter get_angular_velocity returns Vector3

Class: XRServer
  Property: world_origin declared as Vector3 but getter get_world_origin returns Transform3D
```
  
</details>

<details>
  <summary>List of String and StringName mix ups (click to expand)</summary>
  
This might be less relevant for GDScript as it automatically converts between the types. This is however relevant for GDExtensions.
  
```
Class: AnimatedSprite2D
  Property: autoplay declared as StringName but getter get_autoplay returns String

Class: AnimatedSprite3D
  Property: autoplay declared as StringName but getter get_autoplay returns String

Class: BoneAttachment3D
  Property: bone_name declared as StringName but getter get_bone_name returns String

Class: Control
  Property: theme_type_variation declared as String but getter get_theme_type_variation returns StringName

Class: NavigationMesh
  Property: geometry_source_group_name declared as String but getter get_source_group_name returns StringName

Class: NavigationPolygon
  Property: source_geometry_group_name declared as String but getter get_source_geometry_group_name returns StringName

Class: SpringBoneCollision3D
  Property: bone_name declared as StringName but getter get_bone_name returns String

Class: TouchScreenButton
  Property: action declared as StringName but getter get_action returns String

Class: VisualShaderNodeInput
  Property: input_name declared as StringName but getter get_input_name returns String

Class: VisualShaderNodeParameter
  Property: parameter_name declared as StringName but getter get_parameter_name returns String

Class: VisualShaderNodeParameterRef
  Property: parameter_name declared as StringName but getter get_parameter_name returns String

Class: VisualShaderNodeVarying
  Property: varying_name declared as StringName but getter get_varying_name returns String

Class: Window
  Property: theme_type_variation declared as String but getter get_theme_type_variation returns StringName

Class: XRBodyModifier3D
  Property: body_tracker declared as String but getter get_body_tracker returns StringName

Class: XRFaceModifier3D
  Property: face_tracker declared as String but getter get_face_tracker returns StringName

Class: XRHandModifier3D
  Property: hand_tracker declared as String but getter get_hand_tracker returns StringName

Class: XRNode3D
  Property: tracker declared as String but getter get_tracker returns StringName
  Property: pose declared as String but getter get_pose_name returns StringName

Class: XRPose
  Property: name declared as String but getter get_name returns StringName

Class: XRTracker
  Property: name declared as String but getter get_tracker_name returns StringName

```
  
</details>

The script does not check more specific issues, such as Resource hints.

### Steps to reproduce

Does not need steps for reproduction, but to view an example, like I said take a look at the `XRPose` definition and documentation, where `angular_velocity` is a Vector3. Calling `get_property_list()` on an instance of `XRPose` however returns the string type for `angular_velocity`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See the attached file for the script to detect the mismatches.

You can run the project and it will iterate through all classes and show a progress percentage.
It will output the results both to the console and to individual files which will be placed in the project folder.

[PropInfoProblem.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23468154/PropInfoProblem.zip)

---

If there is interest, I would be happy to contribute a PR fixing the types of the incorrect `ADD_PROPERTY` calls. (I don't know if some exceptions should be made, as some properties have for example `PROPERTY_USAGE_INTERNAL`, however it is still possible to access the property, so I would still be for correcting it)
